comment: Per-model tuning: give LeNet, ResNet and MLP their own best settings (the deeper VGG was already tuned in sprint3_tuning.json, stages A and B). Kept separate so the original Sprint 3 grid stays an unchanged record. Evidence for each change is in the Sprint 3 logs: ResNet and MLP hit the 30-epoch cap while still improving; LeNet overfits (train ~100 %, val ~98.9 %) with no dropout or augmentation. Light augmentation is used because it won stage A.

P.comment: Each model at its best. Compare with the same-settings runs in models/experiments/experiment_log.csv (30 Sep rows).
